description: HL7 FHIR R4 health-data backend with patient consent (OAuth 2.1 / SMART on FHIR), provenance, an AI-ready context API and a free sandbox with 30 synthetic patients. TypeScript and Dart SDKs.
rules: Start on the sandbox: use an sk_test_ key and the 30 synthetic patients; never put real patient data in the sandbox and never use sk_live_ keys in examples.

Never invent LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, ICD-11, ATC or RxNorm codes. Look them up with the terminology endpoints (/v1/search, /v1/search/{id}) or take them from the official code system; if a code is unknown, leave it out.

A person's data is read or written only with their consent: request it through the consent flow (SMART on FHIR scopes) and respect its scope and expiry; when the API answers 403, ask for consent instead of working around it.
Store clinical data as standard FHIR R4 resources (Patient, Observation, Condition, MedicationStatement, AllergyIntolerance, Immunization, DiagnosticReport) with UCUM units, not as custom JSON.
Anpheros does not diagnose or recommend treatment; generated apps must not present diagnoses or medication advice to users.
Documentation and guides: https://developers.anpheros.com/guides/ ; documentation MCP server (no account): https://platform.anpheros.com/mcp/docs
